author: Vox
description:
The 2026 midterms are in the rearview mirror, but the electoral map tells only half the story.

So what are the major moments that stood out after eight months on the road? Vox’s Astead Herndon sits down with America, Actually producer Kasia Broussalian to reflect on their reporting across the country—from town halls in New Jersey to gas stations in Pennsylvania, and canvassing in Nevada. They unpack the underlying tensions that defined the midterms and what those moments reveal about the fast-approaching 2028 presidential cycle.

description:
Vox’s Astead Herndon reflects on when he knew President Donald Trump and the Republicans had a major problem going into the midterms — when voters at a gas station in Pennsylvania name-checked the Strait of Hormuz. Looking to 2027, will Democrats be able to resolve these issues?

description:
Scott Colom’s historic Senate win surprised the country. But people in Mississippi have been working toward this moment for generations. Reporter Taylor Vance and Congressman Bennie Thompson explain what the rest of us missed.
